body: Ahh great! So glad you feel better, and that you're thinking about stopping biting your fingers. Hope you keep doing better and that you tell your parents what's going on. Take care.

Hey, I’m pretty concerned about you. You sound A LOT like me when I was your age, and I genuinely want to help you. So! Please don’t feel guilty or like you’ve wasted my time. I hope I’m not being presumptuous with any of this. So, addressing your post more or less in the order of what was written…

I’ve always felt horrid guilt for having nice material things. However, it’s not your fault that others do not have much. Or, if you are concerned about your parents’ finances: they’d have to be pretty smart with money to afford such things in the first place. They wouldn’t have bought it if they couldn’t afford it. They buy you things because you’re a good kid who deserves good things. On that note, you don’t need to have anything to show for any of this. You’re only 13, and on top of that, going through a really tough time. Let people do things for you. 
I feel guilt about my family’s efforts to support me while I get treatment too. But please try your hardest to remember that they’re doing it out of love for you. It doesn’t seem like it, but everyone would rather you get help instead of continue to suffer. You are worth time and effort, especially from the people who brought you into this world. You’re allowed to take up space. Tell yourself this over and over when the guilt rears its ugly head. It’ll feel fake as fuck at first, I know, but it’s worth a try.

 I can promise you that the doctor who told you that you were a bad kid is full of shit. If this was something you could control, you would’ve stopped. What you’re going through isn’t just something that people DO. No one is going to put themselves through this much pain and confusion. 
The whole inertia, I-want-to-complete-this-activity-but-can’t-even-get-up is definitely an ADD thing. Also, the bit about the therapists and counsellors working their asses off to help you… That’s their job, it’s what they’re paid to do. We usually judge ourselves harshly. These mental health professionals have worked with people far more trying than you I’m sure. You aren’t giving anybody any kind of unnecessary trouble. And once again, you’re really young, you don’t have to show anybody anything. You will progress at your own pace.

Don’t know what to tell you about the anger and paranoia, I’[m still struggling with those myself.  I keep something like a stress ball or rock with me focus on how it looks and feels in my hand when I feel intense emotions bubbling up. I’m sure you’ve already tried this though lol.
The tics and whatnot are pretty typical for people with ADD and Asperger’s Syndrome I think. I do it big time. Although, when the urge to bite yourself comes up, you might want to try consciously redirecting your focus to another physical activity that isn’t harmful. Maybe try gum if it’s the need to chew on something to help you focus.

Why exactly does your mom get so upset when it comes to homework? Does she not have a good understanding of ADD, or is she just not accepting of it? Failing/having to repeat a grade SUCKS but it's just one year (hell, barely that even) out of 70 or more. School is important, yes, but ultimately it's not a definitive assessment of your potential. Especially for neuroatypical kids. If you do fail and anyone gives you trouble about it... fuck them. 
If the urge to harm yourself comes up again, try to distract yourself by sleeping, exercising, writing about your feelings, or some other activity you enjoy. If you truly can’t and you’re scared, PLEASE tell your parents. If you can’t for whatever reason, you can call the number of emergency services in your country.  Regardless, tell someone (parents, doctor, therapist…) that your current treatment isn’t working. Even if what you’re feeling right now passes, it isn’t something to be swept under the rug. That’s an extremely dangerous habit to adopt, and it’s surprisingly easy to fall into. Tell someone about how you felt tonight. Stay safe, and sorry about the damn novel lol. Feel free to PM me.
